originalTitle: Trump is giving Nick Shirley $10,000 and launching a $25 million fraud bounty program

content: Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance said on Tuesday that the Trump administration was giving right-wing YouTuber Nick Shirley $10,000 and launching a $25 million bounty program for members of the public to report fraud. In December 2025, Shirley published a viral video alleging fraud at daycares in Minnesota that were operated by members of the local Somali community. Shirley lingered in parking lots and asked to enter childcare centers, taking refusals as evidence that the centers weren’t actually caring for children. The video quickly went viral, triggering a massive governmental response: Federal immigration agents descended on the Minneapolis area, and the Trump administration froze Minnesota’s federal funding for childcare. Shirley has since visited other states in the US under similar pretenses, showing up unannounced to grocery stores and hospice centers in search of evidence of fraud. Vance and others in the administration publicly praised Shirley, who has since become a mainstay in the MAGA-aligned content creator ecosystem. He’s helped popularize a genre of so-called independent journalism popular on the right in which content creators and influencers confront businesses or people they suspect of fraud or crime as the basis for their online content. Harassment — or even immigration crackdowns — often follow. The administration told Fox News that it was also launching the Fraud Whistleblower Incentive Program (WHIP), a pool of $25 million open to anyone who believes they’ve witnessed fraud. A “particular emphasis” is placed on fraud in hospice, home healthcare, daycares, and special services, a government website says. A chatbot collecting responses instructs the reporting party: “Briefly describe what you saw, heard, or read. A few sentences are enough. Include names, dates, amounts, or records if you have them, and how you know. Note any details you’re unsure about.” According to Fox News and the reporting portal, members of the public who flag fraud are eligible to get up to $30,000 if a tip submitted leads to a conviction or significant federal action. But speaking on Tuesday, Trump contradicted the $30,000 ceiling. ”If you turn somebody in and … you find $1 billion, we are giving a commission to that person of 1 percent,” Trump said today. (One percent of $1 billion would exceed the $30,000 cap.) “And if it’s $10 billion, $200 billion, $400 billion, we’re giving a 1 percent commission to that person,” Trump continued. The White House didn’t immediately clarify how the $10,000 payment to Shirley was calculated or how the program is being funded in the first place. Shirley’s methods have been criticized particularly in Minnesota, where sweeping fraud investigations were already taking place before he arrived to make content. He accused businesses of faking childcare services based on little more than being denied entry to facilities, and — to the frustration of many — acted as if his video was the first fraud investigation in the state. Subsequent state official visits to the centers Shirley featured found them operating “as expected.”

chineseContent: 唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 和副总统 JD 万斯 (JD Vance) 周二表示，特朗普政府将向右翼 YouTuber 尼克·雪莉 (Nick Shirley) 提供 1 万美元，并启动一项 2500 万美元的赏金计划，鼓励公众举报欺诈行为。 2025 年 12 月，雪莉发布了一段病毒视频，指控明尼苏达州当地索马里社区成员经营的日托中心存在欺诈行为。雪莉在停车场徘徊，要求进入托儿中心，她拒绝了，就认为这些中心实际上并没有照顾孩子。该视频迅速传播开来，引发了政府的大规模反应：联邦移民特工突然袭击明尼阿波利斯地区，特朗普政府冻结了明尼苏达州的联邦儿童保育资金。此后，雪莉以类似的借口访问了美国其他州，未经事先通知就出现在杂货店和临终关怀中心，寻找欺诈证据。万斯和政府中的其他人公开赞扬了雪莉，她从此成为 MAGA 一致的内容创作者生态系统的中流砥柱。他帮助普及了一种在右翼流行的所谓独立新闻流派，在这种流派中，内容创作者和影响者与他们怀疑有欺诈或犯罪行为的企业或个人进行对抗，以此作为其在线内容的基础。骚扰——甚至移民镇压——常常随之而来。政府告诉福克斯新闻，它还启动了欺诈举报者激励计划 (WHIP)，向任何认为自己目睹了欺诈行为的人开放 2500 万美元的资金池。政府网站称，“特别强调”临终关怀、家庭医疗保健、日托和特殊服务领域的欺诈行为。收集回复的聊天机器人指示报告方：“简要描述您所看到的、听到的或读到的内容。几句话就足够了。我
